Where to put a rest stop 2/5 of the way?

Goal: I can find the point that divides a segment in a given ratio, on a line or coordinates. (Supporting lesson for G.TS.2 and G.GF.7.)

slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
To find the point P that is a fraction t of the way from A to B, move t of the way in x and t of the way in y:

P = (x1 + t(x2 − x1), y1 + t(y2 − y1)).

"Partition AB in the ratio 2 : 3" means AP : PB = 2 : 3, so t = 2/(2 + 3) = 2/5. From A(1, 2) to B(11, 7), P = (1 + (2/5)10, 2 + (2/5)5) = (5, 4). This works because the slope triangles from A to P and from A to B are similar.
